title: HEDGE™ — a course for parents in a confused age (v4)
line: An invented parents' course whose every reason comes from real ministry teaching about why someone is trans, 1988–2026 (quoted or paraphrased, each cited to its page), with dated facts beside it.

facts.text: Homosexuality left the US psychiatric manual (Dec 1973) and the WHO's ICD (1990; ICD-10 F66: "Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder").
facts.source: "Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality", Behavioral Sciences 5(4), 2015; WHO ICD-10 browser (F66)

facts.text: DSM-5 (2013) replaced "gender identity disorder" with "gender dysphoria"; "gender non-conformity is not in itself a mental disorder".
facts.source: American Psychiatric Association, Gender Dysphoria Diagnosis (Nov 2017)

facts.text: June 2013: Exodus International announced it was shutting down; its president apologised.
facts.source: RNS in The Christian Century, 24 July 2013

facts.text: ROGD "is not a diagnostic classification or subtype" in the DSM or the ICD, "nor is it under consideration for inclusion in future editions".
facts.source: CAAPS position statement, 26 July 2021 (signatories include the American Psychological Association)

facts.text: "Gender ideology": "a linguistic formula used symbolically to refer in an accusatory manner"; origins in opposition to the Cairo (1994) and Beijing (1995) conferences.
facts.source: UN Independent Expert on SOGI, A/76/152, 15 July 2021, pp. 4–5, paras 9–10
facts.document: United Nations document A/76/152 (pp. 4–5; page images read)

facts.text: ICD-11 (adopted May 2019, in effect 1 Jan 2022) moved gender incongruence out of "Mental and behavioural disorders"; "trans-related and gender diverse identities are not conditions of mental ill-health".
facts.source: WHO FAQ on gender incongruence in the ICD; WHO news, 11 Feb 2022

music: Music: made in code for this tape by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5)
voices: Host, parent, the Prayer Wall's announcer and the faceless "expert": build-time speech synthesis (Supertonic 3, stock voices F4, M4, M2, M3) — the course's and its sellers' self-presentation ("Dramatisation. Voices are actors." on screen). Maya and her family have no voice.
marks: HEDGE™, Ask Hedge, LAST LINE LIVE, The Prayer Wall, the news outlets (NATIONAL 24, THE MORNING DESK, FAMILY NEWS NOW, METRO 7, THE EVENING HOUR, NEWSLINE) and the "phone-line counsellor" are invented. No person is named or shown.
not_used: No 2009 APA report; no death or suicide figures; no country, flag or map; the 1988 manual's conditions on name and clothes; 1977's "recruit" campaign; the research's B material (clinical debate) as tape text.
